name: extension
description: A highly customizable, QoL-focused browser extension for Stardance

scripts.build: esbuild plugins/*.ts --bundle --format=iife --outdir=dist/plugins && esbuild content.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/content.js && esbuild popup.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/popup.js && esbuild importer.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/importer.js
scripts.zip: npm run build && cp manifest.json popup.html popup.css importer.html dist/ && cp -r images dist/ && cd dist && zip -r ../extension.zip . && cd ..
